strategies.name: Injury-shock fade
strategies.entry: Bet the opponent when a club's model line moves >= 3.5 points because of officially designated absences of 1st-string players, and the movement is not matched by the market move.
strategies.settlement: Settle at game final; one unit per game, no doubling.
strategies.data_required: Game log + closing prices + 4 seasons of Wednesday/Friday designations

strategies.name: Pythagorean regression
strategies.entry: Fade teams whose actual wins exceed Pythagorean wins by >= 1.5 wins, and take teams below by the same margin, when the line has not moved with the underlying rating.

strategies.name: Backup-QB total under
strategies.entry: When a club's chart QB1 is officially Out and the QB2 has < 200 career snaps, take the under of that club's team total contribution.
strategies.data_required: Charts (partial) + report (have) + snaps (have via nfl.com/stats) + prices (missing)

strategies.name: Offensive-line collapse
strategies.entry: When >= 2 chart OL starters (incl. the centre) are Out/Doubtful, take the opponent's side in games where the opponent's pass-rush unit is fully available.

strategies.name: Goal-to-go rush stack
strategies.entry: Combine RB1 'anytime TD' with 'over 65.5 rushing yards' only when the opponent is ranked in the bottom third on red-zone defence per play.
strategies.settlement: Settle per league prop settlement rules.
strategies.data_required: Prop prices + red-zone defence splits + snap counts

strategies.name: Correlated game-script parlay
strategies.entry: Two legs priced from one joint simulation of the game (spread + team total), with the dependence term estimated from the model's own simulated games, not from market prices alone.
strategies.settlement: Settle both legs at game final.

strategies.name: Same-slate fade basket
strategies.entry: Up to 3 injury-shock fades within one betting window; legs must be independent by construction (different games, no shared total exposure).
strategies.settlement: Settle at game final; a cancelled leg voids only that leg.

strategies.name: Rest-day asymmetry
strategies.entry: After a short week (<= 4 rest days) travelling from a primetime game, fade the rested team only when the spread exceeds the model line by < 1.5 points.

strategies.name: Line-move vs news check
strategies.entry: Flag games where the market moved >= 2.5 points with no corresponding official designation; treat as a data-integrity signal first and a trade only after verification.
strategies.settlement: No bet by default; review only.

strategies.name: Cross-fitted model-quality benchmark
strategies.entry: Score the originated lines themselves with log-loss and MAE against outcomes on a chronological walk-forward; a strategy may not be promoted until the underlying model beats the naive baseline (home -2.5 / total 45.0).

strategies.name: Alternate-market arbitrage of our own line
strategies.entry: Trade only when our line and the market differ by more than the model's own standard error (not a fixed point threshold), so bet size scales with genuine uncertainty.

strategies.name: Fractional-Kelly with model-error haircut
strategies.entry: Stake = 0.25 x Kelly fraction computed on the interval, using the lower confidence bound of the edge rather than the point estimate, capped at 2% of bankroll per bet.

gates.name: Pre-registration
gates.threshold: Rule, sample definition and stakes frozen in a committed ledger before any outcome is seen.

gates.name: Data integrity
gates.threshold: Every input row has an official source and passes the row-source gate.

gates.name: Minimum sample
gates.threshold: >= 300 settled bets and >= 3 seasons per strategy.

gates.name: Chronological walk-forward
gates.threshold: Fit on season t, test on t+1; no shuffling, no leakage.

gates.name: Out-of-sample edge over baseline
gates.threshold: Beat a naive baseline (home -2.5 / total 45.0) and a market-closing-line benchmark on untouched data.

gates.name: Multiple-testing control
gates.threshold: Benjamini-Hochberg FDR at 10% across all strategies evaluated in a window, and report the number of variants tried.

gates.name: Uncertainty reporting
gates.threshold: Bootstrap 95% CI on ROI, CLV and hit rate for every published number.

gates.name: Deflated Sharpe / PBO
gates.threshold: Deflate the Sharpe ratio for the number of trials and compute probability of backtest overfitting on the full search.

gates.name: Correlation and exposure integrity
gates.threshold: Legs of any parlay must have a documented dependence term; simultaneous exposure across correlated games capped.

gates.name: Capacity and cost
gates.threshold: Model the vig/breakeven and the stake at which the edge disappears before promotion.

promises: No strategy in this list may be scored on data that predates its registration.
Changes to an entry rule create a new id; they do not edit this one.
Numbers with no official source stay blank; they are never estimated to make a table look complete.
Rewards remain notional until an owner decision and legal review exist.
